thread:
Alice: Migrating project redwood-models-mig into the new org next week. Need quota preflight/approval requests:
- us-west1: 8 x A100 (a100-v4), 4 x L4, 2 x H100
- us-central1: 4 x A100, 2 x L4 (backup)
- vCPU and GPUs for the projects, plus 50 static EIPs for test runners
Also need VPC peering + egress increase for inter-project traffic (5 Gbps burst). Opening ticket with GCP but want org approval and billing sign-off.

Ben: @alice can you paste the project number and billing account? Also include expected steady-state vs burst counts and estimated monthly cost.

Alice: Project: 123456789012. Billing account: BAC-0a1b2c. Steady-state: 6 A100 (us-west1); burst to 8 for 2 hours/day. Steady-state L4: 2, burst 4. Estimated monthly GPU cost ~ $55k (on-demand) — will go to Dedicated reserved if we get committed use discounts.

Carla: finance ok in principle but need a line item in the budget tracker and approvals from platform lead. Put a quick cost breakdown and tag me.

Ben: I'll open the GCP quota request. FYI console path:
```
https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=123456789012
``` 
Include this text in the request: "Project migration org->org: temporary burst capacity for model onboarding"

Priya: infra-oncall — any concerns about regional capacity in us-west1 for A100 next week? We've seen availability jitter on A100 in us-west1b.

infra-oncall: We're at 70% pool utilization in us-west1 for A100 this month; 8 nodes is borderline but should be ok if we stagger starts. Suggest adding fallback policy to route to us-central1 if allocation fails. Also recommend enabling preemptible fallback for non-critical jobs.

Julian: Added quota request Q-2021-0897 in GCP support. Ticket: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/78901234

quota-bot: Quota request created (Q-2021-0897). GCP has asked for billing verification and a justification doc.

Alice: Uploaded justification doc to the ticket and pinged GCP reps. Carla — added a cost note to the budget tracker: https://internal.redwood/finance/budget/infra-2026

Carla: Approved pending platform lead sign-off. Please add the rollout plan.

Ben: Platform lead @sean — can you review the rollout & fallback plan in the ticket? Quick checklist added:
- staggered node startup across zones
- fallback to us-central1 with model-variant routing
- preemptible fallback for eval jobs

Sean: Looked — OK on plan. Approve quota request. @ben please attach network egress schematic and VPC peering CIDR list before GCP approves.

Alice: Will attach network diagram (done). Thanks all. I'll update thread when GCP confirms.

quota-bot: Ticket Q-2021-0897 updated: awaiting GCP approval. ETA 48-72h.
